fieldValues.title: Text written elsewhere arrives as one paragraph and cannot be split
fieldValues.statement: I often draft somewhere else and paste the draft into the essay. It arrives as one paragraph, and I cannot break it where I want the breaks: I have to cut each part out and paste it into a new paragraph by hand. I need to put a break where my caret is, as Enter does in any other editor, and take it back if I put it in the wrong place.
